description: Renovate, not Dependabot: Dependabot cannot update bun.lock, so it would raise PRs whose lockfile no longer matches package.json and CI's --frozen-lockfile would reject every one of them.
Requires the Renovate GitHub App to be installed on the repo — this file alone does nothing.
rangeStrategy 'pin' preserves CLAUDE.md §10's exact-version pinning; minimumReleaseAge encodes the 72-hour rule.

packageRules.description: Majors need a human to look at them first.
Toolchain churn is noisy and low-risk — batch it.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: CVE fixes override the 72-hour age rule (CLAUDE.md §10).
